before: In suggesting mode, deleting a whole table and changing cell fill, vertical alignment, or borders wrote untracked edits.
after: They write Word tracked markup: w:del and w:cellDel on every row of the table, except a row the author proposed, which is withdrawn, and w:tcPrChange on each cell of a changed row.
reason: Only the markup a local edit writes changes. Released replicas already preserve, replay, and resolve these row and cell revision forms when they come from a file, and shared nodes, identities, offsets, and synchronization stay unchanged.
